# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::stepper`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

NumericUpDown control: a value with − and + buttons in an input box. Built on the same four
layers as the button (see `button.rs`): a [`StepperLook`](stepper.md#struct.StepperLook) and its settled values, [`paint`](stepper.md#fn.paint), the
Painter-API [`stepper`](stepper.md#fn.stepper) and [`Ui::stepper`](../ui.md#method.Ui.stepper). The app owns the value; the response reports the
step or the value the request asks for.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/stepper.rs:1`

<a id="fn.settle"></a>
### Function `settle`

```rust
pub fn settle(v: f64, range: StepRange) -> Option<f64>
```

`v` clamped to `range`, snapped to its step from `min`, then clamped again (a snap can round past
`max`). `None` for NaN; an infinity clamps to the nearest end before the snap. A step that is not
a positive finite number does not snap. Never panics.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/stepper.rs:130`
